name: Yvridiosuchus
sum: Yvridiosuchus is a machimosaurid crocodyliform from the Middle Jurassic of England and France.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from a French unnamed unit and the Oxford Clay.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Johnson et al. 2019
